citations.evidenceText:
Transformer Block - Attention parallelization
•   In a single go, we get the initial 𝐐𝐊𝐓 table of shape N × N.
•  This results in a score for each query value for every key
   value, including those that follow the query.
•  This is inappropriate for predicting the next word, so we
   add a mask matrix 𝐌 to set the elements in the upper-
    triangular portion of the matrix to −∞ (which the softmax
    will turn to 0), making attention strictly unidirectional.


                  M𝑖𝑗= −∞ ∀ 𝑗> 𝑖
                  M𝑖𝑗= 0, otherwise

solution.justification: Under the stated assumptions the dot-product variance is dk, and dividing by √dk divides variance by dk.

optionExplanations.o2: That would result from dividing S by dk, not by √dk.
optionExplanations.o3: This divides the variance by √dk instead of the square of the amplitude divisor.
optionExplanations.o4: This ignores the change of scale.

steps: The sum of dk such terms has variance dk.

variables.S: sum Σ_r q_r k_r of dk coordinate products

assumptions: All query/key coordinates independent, zero mean and unit variance, so the product terms are independent with variance 1.

variables.M: N×N additive causal mask: 0 for j≤i, −∞ for j>i
variables.P: N×N attention weights, row-normalized over key index r

units.Q,K,V,S,M,H: dimensionless numerical representations; −∞ is a mask sentinel

assumptions: Inclusive causal mask; at least one finite allowed score in each row; scale once; softmax over keys before multiplying values.
